title.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

summary.ja: 実際の2D散乱場を進め、閉曲線Poynting流束と独立な円柱級数を比較します。
summary.en: Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series.

assumptions.ja: c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。
assumptions.en: Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry.

algorithm.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
algorithm.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

validation.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
validation.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

limits.ja: Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
limits.en: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.
